snippet.title: Unhinged - World Premiere Reveal Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Hunger won’t kill you, but losing your mind will.

From London-based studio Unifiq Games comes Unhinged — a retro sci-fi, open-world survival craft game set in a post-apocalyptic 1990s. Mysteriously stranded on a corporate-controlled island, you must explore, build, and survive through a series of deadly experiments known as The Chrono Trials.

This is your world premiere reveal trailer.

Build modular machines, automate your survival, and fight to stay sane in a world where the line between science and madness has long disappeared. Explore a 9 km² sandbox powered by Unreal Engine 5, and uncover the truth behind the experiment that trapped you here.

Unhinged launches in Early Access 2027 for PC, with console versions planned for 1.0.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664200/Unhinged
Join the community: https://discord.gg/9ZqbcnsYjV
Follow Unifiq Games for updates: https://x.com/UnifiQGames
